build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet-18 model using BasicBlock with 2 layers per stage for image classification
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet-50 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 layers per stage
build_resnet101_model: build a ResNet-101 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-23-3 layers per stage
create_custom_resnet: create a custom ResNet model by passing a block class and layer configuration to ResNet
download_pretrained_weights: download and load pretrained ImageNet weights from a URL using the load_url function
